evidence_use: Validates the RMSNorm profiling and generated-code inspection method. It supports no headline performance result or optimization decision.

capture_conditions.reason: The EXP-0001 decisive protocol requires AC Power. Instrumented intervals are diagnostic even under eligible conditions.

generated_code_observations.command: uv run --locked mojo build -I src -D RMS_NORM_PROFILE_ROWS=1 -D RMS_NORM_PROFILE_ITERATIONS=1 --emit asm -o <external-output> benchmarks/rms_norm.mojo
generated_code_observations.shared_reduction_storage: [128 x float], or 512 bytes per threadgroup
generated_code_observations.element_access: Scalar BF16 loads and stores; each thread advances by 128 hidden elements.
generated_code_observations.simd_group_reduction: No SIMD-group reduction intrinsic appears in the emitted Metal LLVM sidecar.
generated_code_observations.boundary: These are compiler-output structure observations, not measured barrier stall time, occupancy, register pressure, cache traffic, or DRAM traffic.

profile_interval_duration.evidence_boundary: Diagnostic instrumented intervals on battery power; not headline benchmark latency.

compiler_spill_events.boundary: No target spill event was reported in this capture. This does not prove that all executions are spill-free.

counter_attempt.run_warning: GPU Service reported error: Selected counter profile is not supported on target device
counter_attempt.result: No named hardware counter is retained. Observed hardware traffic, occupancy, and stall mechanisms remain unresolved.

limitations: This calibration covers only rows=1; representative transition and saturation workloads remain pending.
Battery power and uncontrolled system load disqualify the interval durations from decisive performance use.
The stock Metal System Trace had no selected counter set and the direct counter instrument selected an unsupported profile.
The shared-memory tree and barrier sequence are optimization hypotheses until paired benchmark evidence shows a material effect.
